fields.body: Four raiders, one collapsing sky. Pixel Raiders is a co-op dungeon crawler where every floor is stitched together the moment you drop into it — the same seed, the same rooms, on every platform you own. The Sky Fortress season lifts the whole run above the cloud line: twelve new floating dungeons, a class that fights with weather, and a shared progression track that follows your account rather than your console.

trailer.name: Pixel Raiders — Season 3: Sky Fortress
trailer.description: Ninety seconds above the cloud line: the twelve new dungeons, the Stormcaller class and cross-play.

quests.name: The Cloudbreak
quests.description: Climb out of the drowned quarter and reach the first floating dungeon.

quests.name: Ballast and Bone
quests.description: Cut the anchor chains holding the Fortress to the seabed.

quests.name: The Long Static
quests.description: Survive nine floors with the storm rising a level each time you rest.

quests.name: Sky Burial
quests.description: Return the Lantern Witch's compass to the room it was made in.

characters.name: Stormcaller
characters.description: Weather class — calls lightning down the vault lines, weakest in the open.

characters.name: Ironvow
characters.description: Shield-first raider who takes the hit meant for anyone standing behind them.

characters.name: Lantern Witch
characters.description: Sees one room ahead, and can hold a door shut for exactly ten seconds.

characters.name: Rook
characters.description: Scout who trades armour for a second dodge and a longer reach.

items.name: Aether Compass
items.description: Points at the nearest rift instead of north.

items.name: Stormglass Lantern
items.description: Burns brighter the closer the storm gets — and blinds you at full strength.

items.name: Raider's Sigil
items.description: Carries one death per run back to the party.
